name: npx skills (agentskills.io)
description: Skill source that wraps the `npx skills` CLI (agentskills.io / skill.fish ecosystem) so `:skill search` and `:skill add` can discover and install community skills without a source compiled into aish. This is the reference `provides.skill_source` plugin (design docs/design/plugin-skill-sources.md §4 shape B).
